summary: Diff systematically routes subexpression formatting through self._print instead of str()/direct interpolation, correctly making StrPrinter settings (e.g. sympy_integers) propagate into Eq, Limit, Lambda, Permutation, etc. Change is minimal, confined to str.py, and directly targets the reported bug without altering unrelated behavior (unhandled types still fall back to str() via emptyPrinter, so no regression for non-sympifiable attributes like domain/order).

issues.description: Minor readability/style inconsistency in continuation-line indentation and use of tuple(map(self._print, (...))) in _print_Limit vs explicit self._print() calls used elsewhere in the same diff.
